## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 392 captures during April 2019. The activity recorded for the month reflects the number of people photographed at the site and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. No change to the reported activity is required.

## Image quality

Of the 392 captures, 18 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.6 per cent. The images that could not be graded are excluded from the grading outcome and should continue to be monitored through routine site review. Staff raised no new equipment faults during April 2019.

## Grading

There were 58 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 7 days. This measure should be considered alongside the activity volume and the ungradable rate when reviewing the site’s monthly performance. The results provide the operational record for Market Eye Clinic for April 2019.
